headline: Zelensky speaks to US envoys Witkoff and Kushner as Trump escalates feud
dek: Ukraine launched more than 1,000 drones at Russia overnight Sunday in one of its largest-ever aerial strikes. Fires broke out at the Petersburg Oil Terminal and Ruchi oil depot in St.
sources: Associated Press (wire); Russian Ministry of Defence; St. Petersburg Governor Alexander Beglov; Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy (X); Donald Trump (Truth Social)
fault_line: Is Ukraine's energy-infrastructure campaign justified retaliation for 76 Russian strikes on its own grid, or is Zelenskyy torpedoing Trump's peace talks and spiking global diesel prices?

sections.what_happened: Ukraine launched more than 1,000 drones at Russia overnight Sunday in one of its largest-ever aerial strikes. Fires broke out at the Petersburg Oil Terminal and Ruchi oil depot in St. Petersburg; 1 person killed, 5 injured; St. Petersburg airport restricted operations; Ozon logistics hub and VK data centre also hit; ~20,000 without power in Leningrad region. Russia's MoD says 1,015 drones neutralized over 15 regions, Crimea and Black Sea. Separately: Zelensky spoke Sunday to US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner; Zelensky told FT/Meet the Press that Russia attacked Ukraine's energy sector 76 times since Trump's Oct 11 'energy ceasefire' and that sanctions relief strengthens Putin; Trump on Truth Social claimed Zelenskyy 'doesn't want to end this war' and blamed diesel-refinery strikes for hurting world diesel markets. Ukraine's foreign ministry apologized to Lithuania after a suspected drone exploded over its airspace (possibly diverted by Russian electronic warfare).
sections.what_verified: AP via Al Jazeera (1,015 drones per Russian MoD; 1 killed 5 injured per Gov. Beglov), Business Standard, CNA, Manila Times, Free Malaysia Today; Ukrainian and Russian official statements both confirm scale; Zelensky X post and Trump Truth Social post quoted verbatim across outlets
sections.what_disputed: Kremlin spokesman Peskov (TASS) says Ukraine 'resisting' but cannot change course of events; Trump frames Kyiv's strikes as sabotaging negotiations and harming diesel markets; US intelligence-sharing had been paused ('blocked for some period'), only recently resumed
sections.why_matters: Follow the missiles, not the men: the strike exposes the Trump-Zelenskyy rupture — a US president pressuring Kyiv to capitulate (Zelenskyy's word on Bloomberg) while Ukraine bets escalation buys leverage. Verbatim quotes, both sides.
